description: This file defines a mock class 'OpenCDMSessionMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'OpenCDMSession' and uses Google Mock to mock its methods. It is used for testing components that depend on 'OpenCDMSession' by providing a controllable mock implementation.

classes.name: OpenCDMSessionMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'OpenCDMSession' used in unit testing, providing mock implementations for all virtual methods.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Mock method to initialize the session, with an overload accepting a boolean parameter.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mock method to generate a license request with specified initDataType, initData, and cdmData.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mock method to load an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mock method to update the session with license data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mock method to check if a key ID is contained within the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Mock method to set the DRM header.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mock method to select a specific key ID.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Overloaded mock method to add protection metadata to buffers.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Mock method to close the session.

methods.name: removeSession
methods.description: Mock method to remove the session.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Mock method to get the status of a key.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve the session ID.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mock method to get the last DRM error code.
